scenarios.title: A champion permanent is sacrificed on entering unless it exiles another object of the right type
decisions: A casts Boggart Mob, tapping four Swamps.
Both players pass; Boggart Mob resolves and enters.
The champion trigger goes on the stack; A chooses to exile Goblin Piker.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: goblin_available
variants.expected: Goblin Piker is exiled and Boggart Mob (5/5) stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: no_other_goblin
variants.delta: A controls Grizzly Bears instead of Goblin Piker.
variants.expected: A controls no other Goblin to exile, so Boggart Mob is sacrificed and goes to A's graveyard. Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: When the champion permanent leaves the battlefield, the exiled card returns
decisions: A casts Boggart Mob, tapping four Swamps; it resolves and A exiles Goblin Piker to the champion trigger.
With the stack empty, B casts Unsummon targeting Boggart Mob, tapping Island.

variants.label: champion_leaves
variants.expected: Boggart Mob returns to A's hand. The leaves-the-battlefield trigger fires and Goblin Piker returns from exile to the battlefield under A's control.

variants.label: champion_stays
variants.expected: Boggart Mob stays on the battlefield and the leaves-the-battlefield trigger does not fire. Goblin Piker stays in exile.
